clips.title: The story
paras: Guile of the Raptor is a quest in which Tor'gan seeks to awaken the dormant warrior spirit within Gor'mul. By harvesting the hearts of Highland Fleshstalkers, Tor'gan plans to fashion an enchanted item imbued with the cunning and predatory power of the raptor.

Tor'gan works to restore a listless compatriot named Gor'mul, whose warrior spirit has fallen dormant. Rather than relying on simple persuasion, Tor'gan turns to primal magic to shock Gor'mul back into action. By crafting a charm imbued with the essence of wild predators, he hopes to reintroduce Gor'mul to martial resolve and demonstrate the strength of their new power.

To channel the predatory instincts of the wild, Tor'gan requires the hearts of Highland Fleshstalkers. In shamanic and primal traditions, the heart of a cunning hunter carries its ferocity and guile. Tor'gan weaves both a physical token and a spell from these trophies, aiming to infuse Gor'mul directly with the predator's cunning so he can rediscover his true calling.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With some additional objects, I will be able to create an item that will imbue Gor'mul with the guile of the raptor! With the power of the raptor flowing through him, Gor'mul will know our new power and rediscover the warrior that lies dormant!
I will require raptor hearts to fashion the item and spell.
